core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Blend high-end luxury automotive aesthetics with sterile, high-utility technical CRM interfaces.
Emotion First: The UI should feel like the command center of a supercar. Sleek, precise, zero latency.
Content is King: Dense data tables must be instantly scannable. Use IBM Plex Sans for numbers and technical data.
Negative Space: Use 'p-6' or 'p-8' inside dashboard cards to let metrics breathe.
anti_patterns_avoided: No standard SaaS purple/teal gradients. We use piercing Electric Blue and Deep Obsidian.
No generic Inter font. Using Outfit for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body.
No center-everything layouts. Strictly left-aligned data and asymmetric bento grids for the dashboard.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: The 'Control Room' Grid (Mode B). Dense, functional, strict hierarchy.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-sm (2px - 4px) to maintain a technical, sharp edge automotive feel.
layout_and_spacing.surface_style: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use border-collapse on containers and 1px borders on items to expose the skeleton.

components.buttons: Sharp edges, high contrast text. Transparent with 1px border for secondary, solid primary color for main CTA. MUST have explicit hover state: hover:bg-blue-600 hover:text-white.
components.cards: Flat background (surface color), 1px subtle border, NO soft shadows. On hover: border color brightens, slight -translate-y-px.
components.tables: Dense layout, left-aligned columns, alternating row colors (very subtle bg-white/5), sticky headers with uppercase tracking-wide labels.
components.forms: Shadcn components heavily customized: dark inputs, sharp borders, high-contrast focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-background).
components.modals: Glassmorphism overlay (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm), solid modal body with sharp technical borders.
components.vehicle_map: Custom inline SVG. Top-down view of a car. Use <polygon> for panels (hood, roof, doors, glass). Stroke: #444, Fill: transparent. Hover: fill-primary/20. Active/Selected: fill-primary/50 with stroke-primary. Allow clicking to toggle selection.

app_specific_instructions.currency: Kuwaiti Dinar (KWD). MUST format to 3 decimal places (e.g., KWD 15.500).
app_specific_instructions.quotation_builder: Implement as a multi-step modal dialog or full-page wizard. Steps: 1. Customer/Vehicle, 2. Area Selection (Interactive Map), 3. Services (Paint Protection, Tint, etc.), 4. Review & Quote.
app_specific_instructions.job_card: Include digital signature canvas (`react-signature-canvas`) and dual image upload zones (Before / After).
app_specific_instructions.dashboard: Bento layout. Top row: Key Metrics (Today's Jobs, Revenue KWD). Middle: Chart (Recharts) and Pending Jobs table. Bottom: Low Stock Alerts.

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight. Technical and clean.

login_background.description: Close-up of a sleek black car interior and exterior. Perfect for login/auth screen background with a 50% black overlay.

workshop_context.description: Sleek sports cars in a high-tech automotive workshop. Use for empty states, 'No Jobs' placeholders, or marketing headers within the CRM.

testing.data_testid_requirement: ALL interactive elements, form inputs, buttons, map panels, and tables MUST have a data-testid attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., 'customer-submit-btn', 'vehicle-map-hood').

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI.
Set the Tailwind config to use the dark theme exclusively (or default to dark).
Create the Sidebar and Header layout first. Header must have glassmorphism if sticky, or solid with 1px border.
Implement the Dashboard with a Bento Grid layout.
Build the Interactive Vehicle Map as a standalone SVG component with state for selected panels.
Ensure all monetary values use KWD with 3 decimal places.
Ensure forms use Shadcn UI with high contrast text colors.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for custom layouts where Shadcn cards are too restrictive, preserving the 'Technical Grid' look.
